tools.name: defi_find_best_yields
tools.description:
Use this when you need to find the best DeFi yields for a token across all chains and protocols. Returns ranked opportunities in JSON.

1. pool: pool/vault name and pair
2. protocol: protocol name (Aave, Compound, Lido, Aerodrome, etc.)
3. chain: which blockchain network
4. apy: current annual perce
